title: Workshop Journey inputs (browser-local only)
description: Contract 1.0 for the four-chapter Workshop Journey answers held in the visitor's browser. Status: proposed - subject to A6 math review and professional review (G3). This object never leaves the browser: not in URLs, cookies, storage sent to a server, analytics, error reports, logs, email, n8n, Brevo, Supabase or an LLM (D-014). It has no free-text field and no personal identifier. Semantics: workshop-inputs.md; math: workshop-math.md.
$comment: Generated by .orchestration/evidence/F02/math/build_schema.py. Layer-2 semantic rules (XF-04 start age not in the past, XF-05 end after start, XF-06 unique source ids) cannot be expressed here and are normative in workshop-inputs.md section 6.

currency.description: All money values are integer CAD cents.

base_year.description: Calendar year of the base date; year index t=0. Taken from the device clock and shown to the participant.

allOf.$comment: XF-07: a partner-owned income source requires the household section.

status.description: unknown: not known or skipped (value absent). zero: a stated zero (value 0; the only representation of zero). estimated: an approximate or assumed value. confirmed: taken from a statement or document.

quantity.description: Numeric wrapper. value is an integer: CAD cents for money, whole years for ages/indices/horizon, basis points for rates. Absent when unknown; 0 only when zero; >= 1 when estimated/confirmed.

balance.description: Approximate balance in CAD cents; up to $50,000,000.00.

rateAssumption.description: Explicit annual rate assumption in basis points (100 bp = 1%); 0% to 10%. Cannot be unknown.

chapterLife.description: Chapter 1 - What life do you want to fund?

amount.description: Desired household spending, CAD cents. A household cannot spend zero: use unknown instead.

tax_basis.description: Stated to the participant: spending is money available after income tax.

price_basis.description: Stated to the participant: in today's prices (base-year dollars).

lifestyle_focus.description: Optional single lifestyle choice; stays local; no effect on the math. Labels: C02 (proposed keys).

chapterIncome.description: Chapter 2 - What income is already planned?

allOf.$comment: XF-08a: a complete list has at least one source.
XF-08b: no planned income / not answered means an empty list.

id.description: Opaque local key (src-1 ... src-99). Never a name or label.

owner.description: Whose age an age-based start/end refers to (joint = self).

amount.description: Income amount, CAD cents, on the stated period.

tax_basis.description: gross = before income tax; net = after income tax; unknown = participant not sure.

price_basis.description: Whether the amount is in today's prices or in the prices of the year it starts. Irrelevant (ignored) when already receiving.

escalation_bp.description: q_j: explicit annual increase after the start, basis points; 0% to 10%. Cannot be unknown.

chapterSavings.description: Chapter 3 - What have you built? Every field optional; absent means not entered (treated as unknown).

also_entered_as_income.description: Double-count guard: is this pension also listed as an income source in chapter 2?

excluded_from_spendable.description: Contract 1.0 models no disposal assumption, so only true is accepted. A sale/disposal assumption needs contract 1.1 plus A6 and G3 review.

chapterTiming.description: Chapter 4 - When do the pieces change?

current_age.description: Whole years, 18 to 100; the age used for calendar year t=0.

retirement_age.description: Whole years, 30 to 100, not earlier than current age (already retired: use current age).

planning_horizon_years.description: H: number of retirement years illustrated, 1 to 60, and last illustrated age <= 120. An illustration assumption, not a life-expectancy prediction.

inflation_bp.description: i: annual inflation scenario, basis points.

capital_illustration_return_bp.description: r: optional nominal net annual return, used only by the capital illustration, which is OFF by default.

household.description: Optional household timing (spouse or partner). Ages only; no identity.
